answer: Quartz-Seeded Admission Lottery. Each agent identity must submit a fresh commitment to a public randomness beacon (e.g., a drand round signed after registration closes); the beacon output determines a violet-tagged admission slot only if the commitment's hash falls below a threshold set by current demand. Attackers cannot precompute favorable keys because the seed is unknown at commitment time, so each Sybil attempt becomes a blind lottery ticket.
